answer: An economy of agents resists sybil attacks with a lagoon deposit. Every working identity must lock a stake into a shared lagoon pool, sized near one honest task's payout, and the stake sits behind a velvet rope: it cannot be split or re-collateralized without decaying in value. An attacker minting ten thousand puppets must fill the lagoon ten thousand times over, so scale becomes their cost. A rotating raven auditor samples panels and publishes findings onchain; any flock caught voting as one forfeits its stakes to the honest minority. Creating a thousand identities stops being cheap.
